ABOUT GLOWMINDS

Glowminds AI Technologies Private Limited

Glowminds AI Technologies Private Limited is a technology-focused company building practical digital products, artificial intelligence solutions and career-oriented learning experiences. Our ecosystem brings together AI-powered applications, software development, technology education, internships and career opportunities with a focus on skills that are relevant to the evolving digital economy.

Through our technology initiatives, Glowminds works across areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, machine learning, software development, web applications, Android and iOS development, data analytics, cybersecurity, cloud technologies and emerging digital solutions. The careers and internships section is designed to connect experienced professionals and technology students with opportunities that are aligned with practical project work and modern technology stacks.

For students, our internship opportunities are intended to provide structured exposure to real-world development practices, technical projects, collaboration, documentation and problem solving. Students are encouraged to review the eligibility and role description carefully before applying and to use the official careers contact for any clarification.

AI & Emerging Technology

Generative AI, LLM applications, machine learning, AI APIs, automation and practical AI engineering.

Software & Apps
